activity.notes: Earhart became internationally prominent through the 1928 transatlantic flight and continued a record-setting aviation career until her disappearance during the 1937 world-flight attempt. ATLAS uses 1928-1937 as the representative documented aviation phase.

sources.title: Amelia Earhart — Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum
sources.citation_text: The Smithsonian documents Earhart's 1928 transatlantic breakthrough, later aviation records, and disappearance in 1937.
